Project Development Document

An offline-first Progressive Web App supporting the National Council for Curriculum & Assessment (NaCCA) Common Core Programme, with a Firebase Auth + Firestore cloud layer for accounts, sync and an educator dashboard.

01

Executive Summary

Ghana's NaCCA curriculum demands a learning tool that works where connectivity does not. NACCA QuizBank is a curriculum-aligned, offline-first PWA that turns locally authored question packs into an interactive 5-level drill-down quiz system — and layers on optional cloud accounts so teachers can manage a class and see performance.

Goal

Any JHS classroom can run curriculum-accurate quizzes from a single install, fully offline, with no server dependency. Optional Firebase accounts let educators provision students, sync results and view a class dashboard.

Principle

Offline-first, cloud-optional. Files are the source of truth. Dexie materialises the curriculum into queryable tables; Firebase augments (not replaces) it with auth, cross-device sync and analytics.

02

System Overview

Offline-First
Curriculum, quiz state and progress live in IndexedDB (Dexie). Service worker precaches shell + data packs. Works in airplane mode.
Local + Cloud Data
Question packs import from JSON/CSV (PapaParse + Zod). Optional Firebase Firestore store accounts, attempts and educator analytics.
Drill-Down Selector
Class → Subject → Strand → Sub-strand → Content Standard, with a persistent breadcrumb stepper and Fuse.js fuzzy search.
Deployment model: static build on Vercel (frontend). Firebase Auth + Firestore as the managed cloud backend. PWA install prompt → Add to Home Screen. The cloud layer is entirely optional — the app works with no account.

04

Core Features

Drill-Down Selector

Class → Subject → Strand → Sub-strand → Content Standard. Breadcrumb stepper with Zustand-persisted path so a refresh returns to the exact standard.

Zustand Fuse.js react-router

Quiz Engine

Answer → flag → review → results. Supports mcq, true/false, multi-select, numeric and short-answer. Timer pauses on hidden tab; question map jumps by dot.

mcq/tf/num/multi/short

Offline-First PWA

Installable, workbox caching, offline indicator, precached data packs, background sync queue. Full operation in airplane mode.

Workbox Manifest

Local Data Manager

Drag-and-drop JSON/CSV import, Zod validation, merge/replace, preview table, export, storage usage readout.

PapaParse Zod

Progress & Analytics

Mastery grid, daily streak, strand radar, attempt history and CSV export — all computed from local attempts.

Recharts CSV export

Accounts + Educator Dashboard

Firebase email/password + Google sign-in, email verification, password reset, student roster, class dashboard with per-subject and per-student analytics.

Firebase Auth Firestore

PRODUCT SCREENSHOTS
7 views · desktop + mobile

Data Architecture

Question Pack Schema (JSON)
{
  "meta": { "name": "NaCCA-aligned JHS Quiz Bank", "version": "1.0.0" },
  "classes":        [ { "id": "jhs1", "code": "B7", "label": "Basic 7" } ],
  "subjects":       [ { "id": "mathematics", "name": "Mathematics", "icon": "sigma", "colour": "#4F46E5" } ],
  "strands":        [ { "id": "jhs1-mathematics-s1", "classId": "jhs1", "subjectId": "mathematics",
                        "num": 1, "name": "Number" } ],
  "subStrands":     [ { "id": "jhs1-mathematics-s1-ss1", "strandId": "jhs1-mathematics-s1", "num": 1 } ],
  "contentStandards":[ { "id": "jhs1-mathematics-b7-1-1-1", "subStrandId": "...", "code": "B7.1.1.1",
                        "title": "Demonstrate an understanding of integers in real-life contexts" } ]
}
// questions.json -> { "items": [ { "id","csId","classId","subjectId","type",
//   "stem","options","answer","explanation","difficulty","tags" } ] }
// type: mcq | tf | num | multi | short
Dexie Tables (IndexedDB)
classes / subjects / strandsid, classId, subjectId
subStrandsid, strandId
contentStandardsid, subStrandId, code
questionsid, standardId
attempts++id, standardId, date, subjectId, classId
metakey (seedVersion)
Firestore Collections
users/{uid} — name, email, role, classId
attempts/{id} — userId, standardId, score, total, date
offline persistence enabled → reads/writes cached to IndexedDB

Offline guard: if offline, the quiz uses cached questions only. Timer pauses on visibilitychange. Attempts queue locally and sync on reconnect.
Persisted path: the breadcrumb stepper stores the drill path, so a refresh returns to the exact standard. Progress is also persisted per class.

PWA & Offline Capabilities

Manifest
{ "name": "NACCA QuizBank",
  "short_name": "QuizBank",
  "display": "standalone",
  "theme_color": "#0F172A",
  "background_color": "#F8FAFC",
  "icons": [{ "src": "/icon-512.png",
              "sizes": "512x512" }]
}
Service Worker
  • Precache: shell + static assets (Workbox)
  • Runtime: StaleWhileRevalidate for /data/*.json
  • Background Sync: queue attempts, flush on reconnect
  • Update: autoUpdate, “new content” prompt
Caching Strategy
/data/ → IndexedDB + Cache API
✓ Offline queryable
/assets/ → precache (immutable)
✓ Instant load
Analytics → Dexie + optional Firestore
! Cloud-optional

nacca-quizbank/
├─ public/ — manifest.webmanifest, icon-192/512.png, data/ (curriculum.json + questions.json), robots.txt
├─ src/
│ ├─ main.jsx — seed, SW register, Firebase auth listener
│ ├─ App.jsx — Router + lazy routes
│ ├─ db/ — dexie.js, seed.js
│ ├─ stores/ — drilldown, quiz, offline (Zustand)
│ ├─ components/ — layout, drilldown, quiz, results, data, pwa, auth, home, progress
│ ├─ routes/ — Home, Quiz, Results, Progress, More, DataManager, auth + dashboard screens
│ ├─ lib/ — firebase.js, api.js, grading.js, aggregate.js, progress.js, sync.js, search.js
│ └─ styles/ — index.css → @import "tailwindcss"
├─ scripts/ — generate-data.mjs, migrate-to-firestore.mjs
├─ vite.config.js — react, tailwind, VitePWA, server proxy, manualChunks
├─ vercel.json — SPA rewrite + caching headers
└─ index.html
// vite.config.js
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'
import { VitePWA } from 'vite-plugin-pwa'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react(), tailwindcss(), VitePWA({
    registerType: 'autoUpdate',
    workbox: { runtimeCaching: [{
      urlPattern: ({ url }) => url.pathname.startsWith('/data/'),
      handler: 'StaleWhileRevalidate',
      options: { cacheName: 'quiz-data' }
    }] }
  })],
  server: {
    host: true, allowedHosts: true,
    proxy: { '/api': { target: 'http://localhost:8787', changeOrigin: true } }
  },
  build: { rollupOptions: { output: { manualChunks(id) {
    if (/node_modules\/(?:react|react-dom|react-router|scheduler)\//.test(id)) return 'react'
    if (id.includes('recharts')) return 'charts'
    if (id.includes('framer-motion')) return 'motion'
    if (id.includes('dexie')) return 'dexie'
  } } } }
})

Installation & Setup

Commandsyarn • vite 6 • firebase 12
Install
yarn create vite nacca-quizbank --template react
cd nacca-quizbank
yarn add firebase react-router-dom zustand dexie dexie-react-hooks fuse.js papaparse lucide-react framer-motion recharts
yarn add -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite vite-plugin-pwa
Tailwind v4 entry
/* src/styles/index.css */
@import "tailwindcss";
@theme {
  --color-navy:   #0F172A;
  --color-accent: #FACC15;
  --color-surface:#F8FAFC;
}
Firebase config (.env.local)
VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=...
VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=...
VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=...
VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=...
VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=...
VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID=...
Run + build
yarn dev --host            # → http://localhost:5173
yarn build && yarn preview   # production (registers service worker)
Definition of Done (MVP): installable on Android Chrome; works in airplane mode; drill-down Class → Standard in ≤2 taps per level; 100-question quiz completes offline; results exportable as CSV; initial-load bundle kept modular, charts/firebase deferred.
